It named three schools from memory, none of which was the correct answer, Renzo Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Wall Street. Because the true option never entered the candidate set, every later step worked from a flawed starting list. Later errors, such as the unverified 0.5-mile distance at step 3 and the fabricated schedule claims at steps 5 and 8, compounded the failure but did not cause it.
